answer: Escrowed entry with a public referral graph and peer dispute slashing stops sybil farming. A new identity locks 200 tokens in escrow, its referrer logged publicly as a bridge vouching for the newcomer; anyone may dispute a suspected fake, and confirmed fakes are slashed, half to the reporter. Forging 1,000 identities sinks 1,000 × 200 = 200,000 tokens, strictly linear, while sockpuppet rings spread like yarrow runners, visible as tight islands cut off from the honest core. Honest agents pay one deposit that anchors their standing: never slashed for legitimate work.
